insights: During the morning rush, most trajectories travel from the west part of the city to the east part; during the evening rush, most travel from east to west.
Very long trips occur only at night and run from the city center to the outskirts.
Very short trips occur only within the city center and use walking.
Agricultural-related trips all end in one rural area in the southwest of the city.
summary: This one-day trajectory set has opposing west–east and east–west rush-hour flows, night-only city-center-to-outskirts very-long trips, city-center walking-only short trips, and agricultural trips ending in one southwest rural area.
evidence_policy: Claims describe patterns in this dataset and do not establish causal relationships.
